source_text: Duae semis et novem semis unus populus — Iudaei et gentes in uno Christo. Altare testimonii pacem servat.
pass_a_gloss: Two half and nine half one people — Jews and nations in one Christ. Altar of-witness peace keeps.
pass_b_english: Two and a half and nine and a half are one people — Jews and nations in one Christ. The witness-altar keeps peace.
